title: Tensionless limit of M5-brane and conformal symmetry of its bosonic body
summary: We obtain a tensionless limit of the M-theory 5-brane action and discuss its properties. The consistency of this limit requires that the field strength $H_3$ of the 2-form gauge field on the M5 brane worldvolume is non-vanishing and non-degenerate, so that one can also regard it as a strong $H_3$-field limit. The induced $6d$ worldvolume metric of this theory is non-degenerate in contrast to conventional tensionless (null) $p$-branes.
